limitations: No physical ring is grounded: bond/ring, aft shell, whole upper tube and finite joint compliances are serial.
The scalar path is optimistic parallel sharing; it does not predict actual individual ring reactions, bending, shell ovalization, peel or local crushing.

The larger motor-flank load bounds rail/ring/bond and aft-paper demands; the forward-body reaction is used only for upper tube and joint. This avoids using the smaller joint reaction to clear the mount.
The assumed ring-sector arm is not a verified plate stiffness; actual 3D structure includes direct rail-to-OD transfer and slots.
Upper shortening uses all path force over the whole 778 mm tube and is a bound; actual upstream mass inertia reduces force toward the nose.
Euler values bracket zero and ideal brace support and are not assembled-shell buckling factors.
The retention number is only a same-magnitude reverse-load minimum; recovery opening, extraction, TVC and handling can govern separately.
No peel or mixed-mode allowable is inferred from manufacturer tensile, lap-shear, tear or service-temperature data.

thermal_contacts.thermal_assumptions: Perfect nominal area only; k and cp are estimates. Cure, voids, gap bounds and actual contact reduce/restructure conduction.

method_limits: Numerically verified reduced upper-overlap model, not the complete 3D rail/ring/body/contact assembly.
Upper overlap normal springs retain peel; full-cylinder hoop stiffness and end-load partition are explicit sensitivities.
End bearing is represented by specified independent compressive forces; no end tie or friction/contact capacity is credited.
Estimated elastic properties are inputs; no physical measured data or hot material allowable is inferred.
Whole-tube mass trades are new manufacturing candidates; a bonded wrap cannot be relabeled a thicker monolithic tube.
Missing local crushing, bond peel/mixed-mode envelope, actual ring lateral support, joint bearing contact and positive retention block assembly acceptance.

No peel or mixed-mode allowable is inferred from manufacturer tensile, lap-shear, tear or service-temperature data.

support_before.interpretation: Axial support coverage only; radial gaps, stiffness and actual bonds are separately evaluated, not granted by these booleans.

support_after.interpretation: Axial support coverage only; radial gaps, stiffness and actual bonds are separately evaluated, not granted by these booleans.

summary.mass_inertia_reserve_approximation: Cap bonding and tip seal use the fin-set centroid and inertia; revisit their local distribution before integrated adoption.
summary.interface_distance_scope: Minimum distance verifies some nominal contact at each stated interface, not its complete bonded area or strength. Axial coverage and explicit solids/masses are separate. Cure, voids, free edges and flexible contact remain unqualified.

historical_envelope.applicability: Historical envelope transfer only. Shift/mass/geometry changes require fresh affected JAX/RocketPy/uncertainty runs; no same-candidate flight validation.

summary.load_basis: Maximum of retained 40kPa/5deg screen and CN=2 at maximum q over every matching historical scenario; no design factor applied to deflection, DF3 applied once to strength demands.

layered_panel_quadrature_levels.scope: Piecewise 1D bending/core-shear reduction; includes no gusset stiffening credit and no ideal-root compliance credit. It is not a replacement for three-level installed shell/solid FEA or all-component convergence.

sixth_level_convergence.low_absolute_stress_note: A component below 1% of its DF3 directional allowable can be reported as low absolute stress; this does not waive the regional component mesh-convergence criterion.

historical_FEA_failures_retained.same_criteria: All regional stress components must change <10%; low absolute stress does not waive the requirement. New beam reduction supplies no Syy/tauXY result or installed FEA pass.

open_critical_methods: Same-candidate flight envelope and independent reference comparison after the forward shift and complete mass package.
Three-level installed layered solid/shell FEA: all directional stress components, solid root, curved foot, finite potting, frame/ring/shell/body continuity, local peel and manufactured edge geometry.
Guaranteed hot compression/face-wrinkling/core/bond properties and full orthotropic laminate constants; typical tension alone cannot pass compression.

Finite frame-to-shell gap bonds are explicit and mass-charged; paper through-thickness and all bond-edge peel/normal strength and frame/ring stiffness are unresolved. Rigid-cylinder foot result gives no assembled stiffness lower bound.
Installed torsional stiffness/damping and applicable dynamic bending/torsion/body/TVC aeroelastic calculation. Static divergence and NACA panel sensitivities are not flutter acceptance.

skin.basis: Typical production sheet data, not guaranteed minima; 0.25 mm product is 0.22 +/-0.10 mm and 0.35 kg/m2; E0/90 50.1 GPa, tensile strength 641 MPa. Single ply; compression, 45-degree, transverse and full laminate engineering constants unavailable.

core.basis: Typical density 75 kg/m3, compression modulus 97 MPa, shear modulus 30 MPa, shear strength 1.2 MPa; no hot allowables or thickness tolerance established. The 0.3 mm core tolerance is an explicit conservative study assumption.

assembly.basis: Supplier discusses bonding thin cured sheets to foam using epoxy and preparing the glossy bonding surfaces; this does not establish this root or bond strength.

sources_and_property_status.property_status: The hot reduction, adhesive stiffness, glass-cap and skin shear values are study estimates; retain the existing 45 C substrate screen. Supplier Tg/service/processing temperatures are not a new rocket temperature limit.
